ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a hemisphere projection map centered on the South Pole. Near the center is marked "S," indicating the South Pole; there is a meridian extending downward from the center, and "180°" is marked below the outer circle. Point P is located on this 180° meridian near the outer circle; point M is also on this 180° meridian, and its position is closer to the center than P, that is, its latitude is higher and it is closer to the South Pole. The figure also shows concentric dashed latitude lines and another oblique meridian, with "150°" marked near the outer circle. Reasoning: Points P and M are on the same meridian, so their local time is the same. The question stem says that when the research ship arrives at point P it is exactly sunrise, while M, which is farther south and at a higher latitude on the same meridian, has already had sunrise, indicating that sunrise at M is earlier than at P, that is, the day length is longer in high-latitude areas of the Southern Hemisphere. This shows that at this time the Sun is directly overhead in the Southern Hemisphere, the Southern Hemisphere has longer days and shorter nights, and the higher the latitude in the Southern Hemisphere, the longer the day; the Northern Hemisphere has shorter days and longer nights, and the higher the latitude in the Northern Hemisphere, the shorter the day. Among the four places, Cape Town and Sydney are both in the Southern Hemisphere at about 34°S. Cape Town's latitude is slightly higher, and its day length is slightly longer; Singapore is close to the equator, and its day length is close to 12 hours; New York is located in the mid-latitudes of the Northern Hemisphere, and its day length is the shortest. Therefore the day lengths from long to short are: Cape Town, Sydney, Singapore, New York.

<image1>

method.method_draft: 先读图：该图为以南极点为中心的半球投影，P点在外圈附近的180°经线上，M点位于同一条180°经线且比P更靠近南极，表示M比P纬度更高、在南半球更靠南。再读题：考察船到达P点时正值日出，而同一经线附近、更靠南的M点已经日出。关键判断是：同经线地方时相同，若南半球较高纬度地点比低纬地点更早进入白昼，说明南半球昼长较长，即太阳直射南半球，北半球昼短。然后按四地纬度和半球排序昼长：南半球纬度较高者昼长较长，开普敦约34°S，悉尼约34°S但略靠北或按常见教材排序略短；新加坡近赤道昼长接近12小时；纽约约40°N，位于北半球中纬度，昼长最短。因此从长到短为：开普敦、悉尼、新加坡、纽约。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是以南极点为中心的半球投影图，中心附近标有“S”，表示南极点；从中心向下有一条经线，外圈下方标注“180°”，P点位于这条180°经线靠近外圈处；M点也在这条180°经线上，位置比P更靠近中心，即纬度更高、更靠近南极。图中还画有同心虚线纬线和另一条斜向经线，外圈附近标有“150°”。

推理：P点和M点在同一经线上，所以地方时相同。题干说考察船到达P点时正值日出，而同一经线上更靠南、更高纬的M点已经日出，说明M点日出早于P点，即南半球高纬地区昼长更长。这表明此时太阳直射南半球，南半球昼长夜短，且南半球纬度越高昼越长；北半球昼短夜长，且北半球纬度越高昼越短。四地中，开普敦和悉尼都在南半球约34°S，开普敦纬度略高，昼长略长；新加坡接近赤道，昼长接近12小时；纽约位于北半球中纬度，昼长最短。因此昼长从长到短为：开普敦、悉尼、新加坡、纽约。
method.model_answer: 开普敦、悉尼、新加坡、纽约

raw_record.original_question:
某科学考察船从上海出发，对南半球海域进行考察。读以南极点为中心的半球投影图，回答下列问题。

<image1>

若日出时分考察船到达P点，而M点已经日出，则纽约、新加坡、悉尼、开普敦四地的昼长从长到短应如何排序？
raw_record.answer: Cape Town, Sydney, Singapore, New York
